column1: # Every production host file with a SaveChanges/ExecuteUpdate/ExecuteDelete/ExecuteSql/ExecuteNonQuery call, with its exact count.
# Classes: atomic-audit (record and audit commit together), record-is-audit (the record itself is the evidence),
# outbox-audit (evidence row in the record transaction, delivered later), post-commit-audit (audit appended after commit),
# unaudited (a business or authorization write with no audit: ck-6 debt), n/a (not a business record).
